build_llama_decoder: build a ParlaiLlamaDecoder module wrapping a Hugging Face LlamaModel for decoder-only generation
build_llama_causal_lm: build a ParlaiLlamaForCausalLM model with tied weights from a pretrained Hugging Face Llama checkpoint
run_llama_agent: run the LlamaAgent generative agent with Hugging Face LlamaForCausalLM for text generation tasks
run_llama_classifier: run the ParlaiLlamaClassifierAgent for sequence classification using a Llama decoder with a linear head
setup_llama_args: setup command line arguments for the Llama model including model directory and tokenizer options
